The forecast for SKU S001::P0019 shows a stable demand of about 127 units per day over the next two weeks, so the system recommends ordering roughly 66 units each time (order quantity q = 65.57).  
To keep a 90 % service level while accounting for any small variability, the safety stock is set at about 62 units (s = 61.64), which is consistent with the levels used in previous analyses.  
The reorder point of 1,038 units (r = 1037.86) means you should reorder when on‑hand inventory falls to that level, ensuring you have enough stock to cover lead time plus safety buffer.  
With these parameters the optimization found an optimal solution, costing around $254 ( total expected cost = 254.42 ) and matching the trend seen in past reviews for this SKU.
